analyst.summary: Inox Green Energy Services provides operations and maintenance for wind power assets. The business has just completed a cash-funded acquisition that nearly doubles the capacity it manages under long-term O&M contracts, on top of already-strong recent growth in revenue and profit. Current returns on capital are still modest and the valuation is not cheap, but the balance sheet is essentially debt-free and the recent growth is backed by a real, completed transaction rather than one-off accounting items.
